summary: [SIMULATED JUDGMENT] As a marketing manager or indie hacker running Discord-based influencer programs, I would probably NOT actively search for this solution, and I'd be hesitant to buy it. The pain scores are uniformly low (2s across the board), and willingness to pay is a 1 — the lowest possible. My current spreadsheet workaround is annoying but not painful enough to justify a recurring SaaS subscription. The Discord-specific angle is interesting, but I'd need to see clear evidence that the pain is real and widespread before committing budget. The existing competitors (Refersion, Tapfiliate, etc.) are already affordable and proven — I'd more likely adapt one of those with a manual Discord step than adopt an unproven new tool.
strongest_points: [SIMULATED] Discord-native integration would save me from manually mapping Discord handles to affiliate codes — that's a genuinely tedious step I currently do by hand
[SIMULATED] Automatic commission calculation and payout reconciliation would eliminate spreadsheet errors, which do happen and are embarrassing when I underpay an influencer
[SIMULATED] If priced under $30/month and it integrated directly with Shopify/Stripe, I might try it as an experiment since the spreadsheet workflow does feel fragile as my program grows
weaknesses: [SIMULATED] Willingness to pay is extremely low (score: 1). I'm currently using a free spreadsheet. Jumping to even $29/month feels hard to justify when my program is small and the pain is a 2/5

[SIMULATED] Trust blocker: I'd be skeptical that a new, niche tool could reliably track Discord activity and map it to sales. Discord's API changes, and attribution from Discord to e-commerce is inherently messy. I'd need proof it actually works, not a demo

[SIMULATED] Switching friction: I already have a spreadsheet with historical data, influencer relationships, and a workflow my team understands. Moving to a new tool means re-onboarding everyone and risking data loss

[SIMULATED] Integration requirements: It MUST integrate with Shopify (or my e-commerce platform) AND Discord AND my payout method (PayPal/Stripe). Missing any one of these is a dealbreaker, and building all three is hard for a new tool
[SIMULATED] The pain intensity, frequency, and urgency are all rated 2/5 — this is a 'nice to have' not a 'need to have.' I'd deprioritize this behind literally any other marketing initiative
